reference.host: Apple M6, 24 GB RAM, 12 GPU cores

strata.fresh-process-warm-resource-cache: new browser process and workers; browser resource cache may already be primed
strata.reload-new-workers-warm-resource-cache: same browser process, reloaded page and new workers; resource cache remains warm
strata.cold-network: fresh Chromium process/context; context-wide no-cache routing bypasses browser and job-local Pyodide cache interception; CDN edge may already have the object
strata.reused-healthy-interpreter: same page and Python worker; a second Run uses the same pristine interpreter generation after a completed eligible source execution

pendingCohorts.protocol: fresh process and context with job resource cache interception absent, service workers blocked, and routed no-cache requests; record actual request/response cache metadata and do not claim CDN-edge coldness

seed an eligible source run, then issue a new Run in the same page; require the same Python worker and interpreter generation, pristine trust, and a distinct runRequestId; not completed-history replay

measurementDefinitions.runAcceptedAt: Page epoch timestamp when the current Run is accepted, before clientForRun/interpreter preparation; time queued before page acceptance, including click/dispatch delay, is excluded. sourceRunStartedAt remains the later source-invocation origin used to join causal publications.
measurementDefinitions.firstUsefulMs: Elapsed from accepted Run to completion of the first canvas screenshot containing at least 128 scene-ink pixels.
measurementDefinitions.firstSubmittedMs: Elapsed from accepted Run to the first renderer.render() call completion. This is an upper bound on earlier backend frame submission and the Noon presentation receipt; it is not exact queue-submit start, GPU completion, or physical scanout.
measurementDefinitions.firstControlsReady: Elapsed from accepted Run to an enabled playback toggle observed with a matching current-run presentation.
measurementDefinitions.commandAcceptance: Elapsed time from the actual DOM request event to endpoint acceptedEpochMs sampled after the Rust mutation.
measurementDefinitions.commandPresentation: Elapsed time from the actual DOM request event to a command-correlated Noon presentation receipt; it does not measure physical scanout.

failurePolicy: retain every attempt; missing identities, traces, samples or required arm results fail strict qualification
